text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Historic reduction in inflation moves Spain closer to the Euro
- ETA member that killed the psychologist Elosegui hospitalised with multiple wounds
- Seven Israeli children killed by gunfire by a Jordanian soldier
- Insurrection overtakes the capital of Albania amid mass flight
EL MUNDO
- ETA member Elejalde, hospitalised after being interrogated by the police
- Builder Corrales denounced in writing nine months ago to (Prime Minister Jose Maria) Aznar the corruption in Zamora
DIARIO 16
- Jose Barrionuevo (former interior minister) speaks at last: "There are judges that use the High Court for politics"
ABC
- With the CPI at 2.5, Spain now complies with half of the EU convergence criteria
- Jordan King Hussein interrupts his visit to Spain after learning of the attack against a Jewish school bus on the border with Israel
CINCO DIAS
- Now we have europrices: the CPI drops a tenth in February and brings inflation to 2.5 percent
- Property Law liquifies the municipal gold mine of reassessments
- Cubiertas and Entrecanales rebaptise Acciona
EXPANSION
- Politicians, businessmen and unions urge (Bank of Spain governor) Rojo to cut rates today
- The CNMV (stock market commission) asks fund managers for more transparency with the participants
- Adolfo Dominguez quotes at 3,007 pesetas for retail shareholders
- The government favour Retevision in the interconnection fees
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Spain gets on the road to the Euro with the best CPI in 30 years
- The price of Adolfo Dominguez share offer set at 3,100 pesetas
- Property Law ends speculation by local governments
